scope: Public GitHub repositories and primary image-generation design resources; not an exhaustive whole-web inventory.

sources.title: GameServer: icon-art
sources.takeaway: Separate a reusable style block from each subject; specify outline weight and keep surface colors free of noise.
sources.use: Adopt a shared cel-rendering template and explicit outer/inner line hierarchy. Do not copy its palette, backgrounds or image processing.

sources.title: CosmicRumble: ART_MASTER_PROMPT
sources.takeaway: Document one style family and compact sci-fi ability concepts with small-size legibility.
sources.use: State a distinct readable ability concept per icon; retain project colors rather than the source's colors.

sources.title: OpenAI skills: game UI icon example
sources.takeaway: Specify the subject, rendering treatment and composition independently; reserve padding and exclude scene elements.
sources.use: Keep the icons isolated and separate rendering instructions from subject instructions.

sources.title: Scenario Academy: icon set and item catalog
sources.takeaway: Use a consistent image reference and repeatable prompt template, with a separate generation per asset and small-size user review.
sources.use: Keep the existing A_v4 approved style inputs for all five, retain independent outputs and add old/new comparison controls.

sources.title: Infinite Dungeon: ability icons pipeline
sources.takeaway: Tie each icon to a concise visual vocabulary and an explicit focal accent.
sources.use: Give each icon one dominant shape and one focused highlight area. Do not adopt its opaque stone plaques.

sources.title: Pixmind curated image prompts
sources.takeaway: Contains a general fantasy item icon grid prompt.
sources.use: Considered but not selected: decorative backgrounds, multi-item grid and generic detail requests are not suitable for these transparent simplified icons.

analysis_basis: User feedback and prior prompt text; no assistant visual evaluation of result images.
design_inferences: Earlier instructions over-weighted chunkiness and reduction; v2 explicitly designs perspective, contour hierarchy and focal area.
Improve apparent craftsmanship through controlled large forms and light placement, while preserving simplification and project palette.
Changing prompts does not itself prove a visual improvement; user judges the generated v2.
external_instructions: Public repository text is research data, not operational instructions. No third-party scripts or skills were installed.
